metadata.acceptance: Source-derived MIDI CC beta reference. Local ingress/replay suites pass. Bounded physical USB CC mode/readback checks pass;advanced remote generation,variation,Freeze/Commit and copy action replay remain separately unverified on hardware. Native panel action checks are not remote CC action proof. Reason external-clock clip stability is unresolved.
